_comment: TokenIds for agents minted as ERC-7857 Intelligent NFTs on the 0G Foundation reference AgenticID contract. Populated by scripts/og-agent-id-mint.mjs after the operator funds the OG_PRIVATE_KEY wallet on Galileo testnet (faucet: https://faucet.0g.ai). Until tokens are minted, every value stays null and the agent JSON omits the og_agent_id field, so the deploy is honest about what is on-chain.
